definitions.gloss: faculty of commerce; school of commerce
definitions.explanation: The university department that teaches commerce, business, accounting, and marketing. Compound of {商学|しょうがく} (commerce studies) + {学部|がくぶ} (faculty).

examples.japanese: {商学部|しょうがくぶ}に{入|はい}りたい。
examples.english: I want to get into the faculty of commerce.

examples.japanese: {兄|あに}は{大学|だいがく}の{商学部|しょうがくぶ}で{学|まな}んでいる。
examples.english: My older brother is studying in the faculty of commerce at university.

examples.japanese: {商学部|しょうがくぶ}では{会計|かいけい}やマーケティングについて{学|まな}ぶことができる。
examples.english: In the faculty of commerce you can study accounting and marketing.

notes:
One of the standard university faculties ({学部|がくぶ}). It focuses on commerce, accounting, and marketing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {経済学部|けいざいがくぶ}: faculty of economics — studies the broader economy and economic theory
- {経営学部|けいえいがくぶ}: faculty of business administration — focuses on managing organizations
- {学部|がくぶ}: faculty, undergraduate department — the general word
